items.hook: Standing Room Only is a 1936 comedy novel by the British writer Walter Greenwood.
items.body: Like his previous two, including his bestselling debut Love on the Dole, the work is partly set in his native Salford. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Book of Saladin is a historical novel by Pakistani-born British writer Tariq Ali, first published in 1998.
items.body: The second in Ali’s Islam Quintet, the narrative purports to be the memoir of the 12th-century Muslim leader Saladin, or Salah al-Din, who famously captured Jerusalem from the Crusaders in 1187. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Peptides are the latest wellness trend – but do they work?
items.body: A drug advisory committee in the US has recommended approval for several experimental peptides. But there have been no large-scale tests of these new compounds in humans, finds columnist Grace Wade
